hook.text: 16 hours, 2 jobs. You think Allah forgot you?

end.text: 16 hours, 2 jobs. You think Allah forgot you?
end.gold: On your break today: two rak'ahs. Tell Him you're tired.

captions: 5:40 a.m. Your shift starts at six.
Mist over the river. Your legs still ache from yesterday.
Rent. Your little brother's school fees. Mum's medicine.
On the bridge, you whisper: “Maybe He forgot me.”
An old man rows past, whispering “Alhamdulillah” with every stroke.
Allah knew your load before you ever carried it.
On the train to job two, you close your eyes.
No speech. Just: “Ya Allah, You know I'm tired.”
Same rent. Same shifts. But you're not carrying it alone.

verses.text: “Allah does not charge a soul except [with that within] its capacity.”

post.caption:
16 hours, 2 jobs. You think Allah forgot you? 🌙

5:40 a.m. on the bridge, legs aching, rent and fees and medicine on your shoulders. You whisper: “Maybe He forgot me.” He didn't. He knew your load before you ever carried it.

“Allah does not charge a soul except [with that within] its capacity.” (2:286)

On your break today: two rak'ahs. Tell Him you're tired.
